name: TWINT Payments via Stripe
description: Swiss TWINT checkout through a merchant-authorized Stripe payment service provider using the shared Stripe payment extension image.

stripeSecretKey.label: Stripe secret key
stripeSecretKey.description: Stripe account key with TWINT enabled for your merchant account.

webhookSecret.label: Stripe webhook signing secret
webhookSecret.description: Signing secret for checkout.session events sent to Artio's provider webhook endpoint.

testMode.label: Use Stripe test mode
testMode.description: Defaults to test mode; live mode must be enabled explicitly.

allowedPaymentMethods.label: Allowed payment method filter
allowedPaymentMethods.description: Set exactly ["twint"] to restrict this provider instance to dynamically eligible TWINT checkout.
